Abiotic Disease Abiotic diseases are conditions that are not caused any living organisms such bacteria or viruses. Instead they are caused nonliving factors like deficiencies of certain nutrients (i.e.calcium, magnesium, or potassium, etc), lack of water supply, over- or underexposure to the sun, overwatering, unfavorable soil structure or exposure to extreme temperatures. See the symptoms and signs of each disease below to better diagnose and cure your plant! Remember that plant may have several problems the same time.
